integrity: Exact determinant calculations and a complete adjugate/kernel proof; included verifier is a consistency certificate, not a replacement for the infinite-field argument.
scientific_limitations: Only the rank-exactly-four singular locus of the Hessian quintic is classified. The rank-at-most-three stratum is not addressed. Historical priority for the special-characteristic classification remains subject to unindexed literature; independent review has not occurred.
title: Eleven corank-one Hessian nodes of the Klein cubic in characteristic three
